content:
200
Returns a list of available filters for access groups. The response includes supported filter operators
for each filter. Filter operators can include:
eq—Filters on exact matches of the specified value.
match—Filters on partial matches of the specified value.
date-lt —Filters on dates earlier than the specified date.
date-gt—Filters on dates later than the specified date.
date-eq—Filters on dates equal to the specified date.
set-has—Filters on exact matches of the specified tag_uuid .
The response sample shown does not represent a complete list of supported filters.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
Array of strings
The fields you can use as a wildcard ( wf  parameter) value in the GET
/access-groups endpoint.
Array of objects
The filters and operators for each field you can use when constructing
filter ( f  parameter) values in the GET /access-groups endpoint.
wildcard_fields
filters
Array of objects
The fields you can use when constructing sort  parameter values for
the GET /access-groups endpoint.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
